facts.fact: Finance minister Alain Ndikumana said on 11 June 2026 that BIF 16 billion is provided in the draft 2026-2027 budget bill to finance the biometric national identity card; the bill was proposed and not yet enacted, and the source does not say how much of it is paid by a donor.
